title: AMC PR Admin Manifest
description: Single source of truth for PR ceremony level per AMC Simple PR Admin Model (SPAM-001). Authority: CS2 — Issue #1163.

type.description: PR classification type. Only 'product-fix' and 'docs-only' qualify for simple admin ceremony.

requires_iaa.description: Whether IAA final assurance is required. MUST be true for governance-control, agent-contract, migration, deployment, high-risk.

requires_ecap.description: Whether ECAP ceremony is required. MUST be true for governance-control, agent-contract, migration, deployment, high-risk.

scope_summary.description: Brief human-readable description of what this PR does.

created_by.description: Agent or user ID that created this manifest.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this manifest was created.
